title.en: Samuel de Champlain · Mapping, alliances and a colonial project
title.zh: 塞缪尔·德·尚普兰 · 制图、联盟与殖民计划

location.label: Québec; colonial settlement and administrative setting

summary.en:
Samuel de Champlain’s North American career joined navigation and writing to a project of French settlement and Christian conversion. His birth date remains disputed, so this biography begins with his documented 1603 St Lawrence voyage alongside François Gravé du Pont. At Tadoussac and farther upriver, French visitors entered an Indigenous political and trading world with its own leaders, routes and priorities. Champlain recorded encounters and sought information rather than independently discovering an empty interior.

After voyages along the Atlantic coast, he established a French base at Québec in 1608 under Pierre Dugua de Mons. Maintaining it required supplies, trading arrangements and repeated appeals to patrons in France. Alliances also carried military obligations. He joined Indigenous allies against Haudenosaunee opponents in 1609 and later campaigns, making his commercial and diplomatic relationships part of existing conflicts.

In 1613 he travelled up the Ottawa River. Tessouat challenged an interpreter’s claim about a northern sea and resisted extending the journey, asserting control over access and trade. Champlain’s ambitions did not determine what his hosts would permit. In 1615 he reached Wendat country and joined another military expedition; injury contributed to an extended stay through the following winter.

Maps and published narratives connected these experiences to French readers and officials. His 1632 Paris publication incorporated a map drawing on his observations, other European navigators and Indigenous knowledge. Mapping also named and claimed places for a colonial enterprise. English seizure of Québec in 1629 interrupted his administration; he returned in 1633 and died there in 1635. Following these episodes reveals both his sustained institution-building and the knowledge, choices and resistance of people whose world his project sought to change.
summary.zh:
塞缪尔·德·尚普兰在北美的事业，把航海和写作与法国定居、基督教传教计划联系起来。其出生年份仍有争议，因此本传从有据可查的1603年圣劳伦斯河航行写起；他当时与弗朗索瓦·格拉韦·杜蓬同行。在塔杜萨克及上游，法国来访者进入了原住民已有的政治和贸易世界，那里拥有自己的领袖、道路与优先事项。尚普兰记录接触并寻求信息，并非独自发现一片空白内陆。

在大西洋沿岸航行后，他于1608年受皮埃尔·迪居亚·德·蒙之命在魁北克建立法国据点。维持据点需要补给、贸易安排及反复向法国资助者争取支持。联盟也带来军事义务：1609年及后来战役中，他随原住民盟友对抗豪德诺索尼，使商业和外交关系卷入当地已有的冲突。

1613年，他沿渥太华河上行。泰苏阿质疑一名译员关于北方海洋的说法，并抵制继续前进，以维护对通行和贸易的控制。尚普兰的雄心无法决定东道主允许什么。1615年，他到达温达特地区并参加另一场军事行动；受伤促使他逗留在当地度过1615—1616年的冬天。

地图与出版叙述把这些经历传给法国读者和官员。1632年在巴黎出版的著作包含地图，综合个人观察、其他欧洲航海者与原住民知识。制图也通过命名为殖民事业主张土地。1629年英军夺取魁北克中断其行政活动；他1633年返回，1635年在当地去世。这些经历既显示他持续建设殖民机构，也让读者看见其计划试图改变的世界中，人们自身的知识、选择与抵抗。

dateNote.en: Documented public-career focus 1603–1635, not a complete lifespan. Birth-year alternatives are unresolved. River and Wendat-country points mark representative regional settings; the 1632 Paris point dates publication, not a mapped travel leg.
dateNote.zh: 关注有据可查的1603—1635年公共事业，并非完整生卒年。出生年份的不同说法未解决。河流及温达特点位表示区域环境；1632年巴黎节点标示出版，不构成绘制的旅行路线。

title.en: Mapping New France · Information, intermediaries and territorial claims
title.zh: 绘制新法兰西 · 信息、中间人与领土主张

location.label: Ottawa River corridor; representative knowledge-exchange setting

summary.en:
Champlain’s maps were products of encounters and compilation. The 1613 Ottawa River journey reveals how geographic information moved through interpreters and political relationships. Nicolas de Vignau’s report about reaching a northern sea was challenged by the Algonquin leader Tessouat. The Dictionary of Canadian Biography leaves the report’s exact truth unresolved. Tessouat’s refusal to guide the French onward also protected control of a strategic portage and the trade passing through it.

Printed maps combined personal observations with other navigators’ work and information supplied by Indigenous people. The 1616 map incorporated recent inland journeys, while the 1632 Paris publication presented a larger geographical and colonial account. Naming features was part of claiming places; a map could serve royal negotiation and promotion as well as orientation.

The subject is therefore the movement and appropriation of knowledge, not another account of Québec’s founding or a general fur-trade overview. Indigenous leaders could disclose information, withhold access and redirect a visitor’s plans. At the same time, French publication gathered diverse contributions under one author’s name. These records support questions about whose knowledge became visible in print. They do not provide a surveyed reconstruction of every journey or authorize new territorial outlines for the atlas.
summary.zh:
尚普兰的地图来自接触与汇编。1613年的渥太华河之行显示，地理信息通过译员和政治关系流动。尼古拉·德·维尼奥声称到达北方海洋，阿尔冈昆领袖泰苏阿对此提出质疑。《加拿大人物传记辞典》并未认定报告的确切真伪。泰苏阿拒绝继续带领法国人前进，也维护了对关键陆上转运道及其贸易的控制。

印刷地图把个人观察、其他航海者的成果与原住民提供的信息结合。1616年地图纳入最近的内陆旅行，1632年的巴黎出版物则呈现更广的地理与殖民叙述。为地物命名也是主张地方的方式；地图既可供定向，也可服务王室谈判和宣传。

本条关注知识的流动与占用，而非再次叙述魁北克建城或概括整个毛皮贸易。原住民领袖能够提供信息、拒绝通行并改变来访者计划。同时，法国出版把不同人的贡献汇入一位作者名下。这些记录支持追问：谁的知识在印刷品中变得可见？它们并不构成每次旅行的实测重建，也不授权图谱绘制新的领土轮廓。

dateNote.en: 1613–1632 follows selected encounters and published maps. The 1616/1632 map dates are distinct from the dates of every observation incorporated in them. No map geometry or route leg is added.
dateNote.zh: 1613—1632年追踪所选接触与出版地图。1616及1632年的地图日期，不等于所纳入每项观察的日期。不新增地图几何或路线段。

title.en: John A. Macdonald · Coalition-building and coercive nation-making
title.zh: 约翰·A·麦克唐纳 · 联盟政治与强制性的国家建构

location.label: Ottawa; representative federal government setting

summary.en:
John Alexander Macdonald’s life connected a Kingston legal practice to the construction of a federal state. Born in Glasgow in 1815, he came to Upper Canada with his parents as a child. Legal training, business relationships and local politics gave him connections before his 1844 election to the Province of Canada’s assembly. His career depended on coalition, including cooperation with George-Étienne Cartier and French Canadian Conservatives, rather than the work of one founder acting alone.

He became the new Dominion’s first prime minister in 1867. His government expanded federal territory and institutions while disputes over land and authority continued. The Pacific Scandal exposed campaign financing linked to a railway contract and forced his resignation in 1873. After years in opposition, he returned to office in 1878 with a protectionist programme. Higher tariffs followed in 1879; railway financing and western settlement formed connected aspects of his administration’s plans.

The same state-building imposed exclusion and coercion. As superintendent general of Indian Affairs from 1878 to 1887, Macdonald bore direct responsibility for policy toward First Nations. His government expanded federally supported residential schooling in 1883, an assimilationist programme that separated children from communities. In the western interior, officials used control over food supplies to force people onto reserves amid the destruction of bison-based livelihoods. Chinese workers’ contribution to the railway was followed by discriminatory voting and immigration measures, including the 1885 head-tax law.

Macdonald died in Ottawa in 1891. His political skill and institution-building belong in the same history as these policies and their unequal consequences. His biography does not turn Confederation into the origin of all peoples’ histories or attribute later governments’ actions indiscriminately to his years in power.
summary.zh:
约翰·亚历山大·麦克唐纳的一生，把金斯顿律师事务与联邦国家建构连接起来。他1815年出生于格拉斯哥，幼年随父母来到上加拿大。法律训练、商业关系与地方政治为他建立网络，1844年当选加拿大省议会议员。其事业依靠联盟，包括同乔治—艾蒂安·卡蒂埃及法裔加拿大保守派合作，而非一位建国者独自行动。

1867年，他成为新自治领首任总理。政府扩展联邦领土和机构，土地与权威争议却持续存在。太平洋丑闻揭露与铁路合同相连的竞选筹款，迫使他1873年辞职。在野数年后，1878年以保护主义纲领重新执政。1879年提高关税；铁路融资和西部定居也是相关施政计划。

同一国家建构过程施加了排斥与强制。麦克唐纳1878至1887年兼任印第安事务总监，对第一民族政策负有直接责任。其政府1883年扩展联邦支持的寄宿学校，以同化为目标使儿童与社群分离。在野牛生计遭破坏的背景下，西部内陆官员通过控制食物供应，迫使人们进入保留地。华工建设铁路的贡献，也伴随着歧视性的投票和移民措施，包括1885年的人头税法。

1891年，他在渥太华去世。政治技巧及机构建设必须与这些政策及其不平等后果一同理解。本传不把联邦成立当作所有民族历史的起点，也不把后来政府的行为不加区别地归于其执政年代。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1815–1891; exact birth day is omitted because registered and family-celebrated dates differ. Prime-ministerial terms were 1867–1873 and 1878–1891. The 1876 Indian Act was enacted while he was in opposition; this entry does not assign its enactment to his government.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1815—1891年；登记与家庭庆祝的生日不同，故不列具体日。总理任期为1867—1873及1878—1891年。1876年《印第安人法》通过时他在野，本条不将该法制定归于其政府。

title.en: National Policy · Tariffs, land and the reach of the federal state
title.zh: 国家政策 · 关税、土地与联邦国家的扩张

location.label: Ottawa; representative federal government setting

summary.en:
Macdonald returned to power in 1878 promising tariff protection, and his government introduced higher import duties in 1879. This National Policy sought to strengthen Canadian manufacturing and reduce competition from imported goods. Its effects were uneven; political support and national integration did not mean that every household, region or producer benefited equally.

Tariffs, railway finance and western settlement connected distinct legal and administrative measures. Federal subsidies and land grants supported the Canadian Pacific Railway, while control of land administration and Indian Affairs gave Ottawa instruments for reshaping the Prairies. These were inhabited homelands, not vacant spaces awaiting economic development. Officials’ control of food relief helped compel First Nations onto reserves as bison-based livelihoods collapsed. The policy history therefore includes coercive administration alongside the movement of goods and settlers.

Economic participation did not confer equal membership. Chinese labour was recruited for railway construction, while federal voting restrictions and the 1885 immigration law imposed racial exclusion. The head-tax statute received assent in 1885 and came fully into effect in 1886. Studying these linked arrangements explains a mechanism of state-building rather than repeating the last-spike ceremony. The selected interval ends with Macdonald’s death; tariff politics, federal expansion and the consequences of dispossession continued afterward.
summary.zh:
麦克唐纳1878年凭提高关税保护的主张重新执政，政府1879年增加进口税。这项“国家政策”旨在加强加拿大制造业，降低进口货物的竞争。影响分配并不均衡；政治支持与国家整合不意味着每个家庭、地区或生产者都同样受益。

关税、铁路融资与西部定居把不同的法律和行政措施联系起来。联邦补贴与土地拨赠支持加拿大太平洋铁路，土地管理及印第安事务权力则为渥太华重塑草原地区提供工具。那里是有人居住的家园，并非等待开发的空地。野牛生计崩溃时，官员控制食物救济，协助迫使第一民族进入保留地。因此，经济政策史既包括货物和定居者流动，也包括强制行政。

参与经济并不带来平等成员资格。铁路招募华人劳动，同时联邦投票限制及1885年移民法施加种族排斥。人头税法1885年获御准，1886年全面生效。研究这些相互联系的安排，是解释国家建构的机制，而非重述最后一根道钉仪式。所选时间段以麦克唐纳去世结束；关税政治、联邦扩张和失地后果此后继续。

dateNote.en: 1878–1891 follows Macdonald’s second administration. Tariffs changed in 1879; the 1885 Chinese Immigration Act came fully into effect on 1 January 1886. These related measures were not one statute, and the interval does not date the whole history of dispossession.
dateNote.zh: 1878—1891年追踪麦克唐纳第二阶段执政。关税于1879年调整；1885年《华人移民法》于1886年1月1日全面生效。相关措施并非一部法律，此时段也不是失地历史的全部。

title.en: Tommy Douglas · Ministry, social reform and public insurance
title.zh: 汤米·道格拉斯 · 牧职、社会改革与公共保险

location.label: Regina; representative provincial government and policy setting

summary.en:
Tommy Douglas moved from Baptist ministry into politics through a conviction that religious service required changes to material conditions. Born in Falkirk in 1904, he grew up in a working-class family and spent formative years in Winnipeg. Ministry in Weyburn during the Depression exposed him to unemployment, debt and barriers to medical care. He organized practical assistance while developing connections with labour activists and the Co-operative Commonwealth Federation.

He won a federal seat in 1935 and led the Saskatchewan CCF to provincial victory in 1944. His administration expanded public utilities, labour protections and social programmes. A hospital insurance plan began in 1947, creating a foundation for wider debates about how care should be financed. This was collective institution-building by ministers, officials, community groups and voters, not the work of a single politician alone.

His reforming record also contains troubling ideas. His 1933 sociology thesis advocated eugenic measures, including sterilization of people classified as intellectually disabled. That proposal belongs in an account of his thinking alongside later advocacy of social rights; public-service ambitions could coexist with ideas that threatened personal autonomy.

In 1961 he left the premiership for leadership of the new federal NDP. He had promoted Saskatchewan’s physician-service insurance programme, but legislation became law after his departure and the 1962 confrontation with doctors was handled under Premier Woodrow Lloyd. Douglas continued federal politics, including representation of British Columbia constituencies, and retired from Parliament in 1979. He died in Ottawa in 1986. His life links moral argument to electoral organization and provincial capacity, while keeping the chronology of advocacy, legislation and implementation distinct.
summary.zh:
汤米·道格拉斯从浸礼会牧职转入政治，源于他认为宗教服务应改变物质生活条件的信念。他1904年生于福尔柯克，在工人家庭长大，成长中的重要岁月在温尼伯度过。大萧条期间在韦本的牧职，使他面对失业、债务及就医障碍。他一面组织实际援助，一面同劳工活动者及合作平民联盟建立联系。

1935年，他赢得联邦议席，1944年领导萨斯喀彻温省合作平民联盟赢得省选。政府扩展公共事业、劳动保护与社会项目。1947年开始实施医院保险，为更广泛的医疗筹资争论奠定基础。这是部长、官员、社群与选民共同建设机构的过程，并非单一政治家独力完成。

其改革经历也包含令人不安的思想。1933年的社会学论文鼓吹优生措施，包括对被归类为智力障碍的人施行绝育。讨论其思想时，必须将这一主张与后来的社会权利倡议一同呈现；公共服务理想可能与危及个人自主的观点并存。

1961年，他离开省长职位，领导新成立的联邦新民主党。他推动了萨省医生服务保险方案，但法案在其离职后才成为法律，1962年与医生的冲突由继任省长伍德罗·劳埃德应对。此后继续参与联邦政治，也曾代表不列颠哥伦比亚选区，1979年退出国会，1986年在渥太华去世。其生平把道德论辩、选举组织及省级施政能力联系起来，同时区分倡议、立法与实施的时间。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1904–1986. Hospital insurance began in 1947; physician-service insurance was a later programme implemented after his 1961 departure. Conflicting migration, ministry-start and party-leadership-end dates in the references are not plotted.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1904—1986年。医院保险始于1947年；医生服务保险是后来方案，在其1961年离职后实施。参考资料对迁居、开始牧职及党魁卸任时间的分歧未绘为节点。

title.en: Saskatchewan Medicare · A public programme contested and negotiated
title.zh: 萨省医疗保险 · 争论与谈判中的公共制度

location.label: Regina; representative provincial government and policy setting

summary.en:
Saskatchewan’s medical insurance developed through several institutions and stages. The 1947 hospital plan covered hospital services; extending public insurance to physicians’ services raised another set of political and administrative questions. Experience in the Swift Current health region brought residents and providers together around a broader services plan, but a province-wide proposal faced organized medical opposition.

The CCF campaigned on public medical insurance in 1960. A bill was introduced in October 1961 and became law in November, after Tommy Douglas had left the premiership. Woodrow Lloyd’s government therefore carried the programme through its most visible confrontation. The programme took effect on 1 July 1962, when doctors began a withdrawal of services. Government and medical representatives negotiated, while community clinics offered another way to organize access.

Agreement was reached on 23 July 1962. That settlement belongs to a history of financing, professional autonomy, electoral decisions and collective organization. It cannot be reduced to one leader announcing a benefit, nor should hospital insurance and physician-service coverage be treated as the same milestone. The selected window connects an earlier hospital foundation to the contested provincial implementation. Later federal legislation and the development of coverage across Canada require their own chronology; this record does not establish that all barriers to care disappeared in 1962.
summary.zh:
萨斯喀彻温的医疗保险通过多个机构和阶段发展。1947年的计划覆盖医院服务；将公共保险扩展到医生服务，则提出另一组政治与行政问题。斯威夫特卡伦特卫生地区的经验，让居民和服务提供者围绕更广的服务计划合作，但全省推广面对有组织的医疗界反对。

合作平民联盟在1960年选举中主张公共医疗保险。法案1961年10月提出，11月成为法律，当时汤米·道格拉斯已离开省长职位。因此，伍德罗·劳埃德政府带领制度经历最显著的冲突。方案于1962年7月1日生效，医生同日开始撤出服务。政府与医疗代表展开谈判，社区诊所则提供另一种组织就医服务的方式。

1962年7月23日达成协议。该安排属于筹资、专业自主、选举决定及集体组织的历史，不能缩减为一位领袖宣布福利；医院保险与医生服务保险也不应视作同一节点。所选时段从早期医院保险基础延伸至有争议的省级实施。后来的联邦立法与全加拿大覆盖发展另有时间线；本条不证明所有就医障碍都在1962年消失。

dateNote.en: 1947–1962 follows hospital insurance through the physician-service programme’s 1 July 1962 commencement and the 23 July agreement. The policy continued afterward; the two July dates identify different steps.
dateNote.zh: 1947—1962年追踪医院保险至医生服务方案1962年7月1日生效及7月23日达成协议。政策此后继续；两个7月日期标示不同步骤。

title.en: Terry Fox · Athletic practice becomes a public appeal
title.zh: 特里·福克斯 · 从体育实践到公共倡议

location.label: Port Coquitlam;upbringing and training community

summary.en:
Terry Fox’s public campaign grew from a life shaped by family, sport, disability and relationships with other people facing cancer. Born in Winnipeg in 1958, he grew up in British Columbia and pursued basketball and other sports with sustained practice. His right leg was amputated at New Westminster in 1977 after a bone-cancer diagnosis. During treatment, encounters with other patients helped turn a personal athletic challenge into a commitment to raise money for research.

He joined wheelchair basketball and trained for distance running with an adapted prosthesis. Teammates, friends, medical staff and equipment specialists supported this work. A 1979 race in Prince George with Doug Alward and his brother Darrell helped prepare the next step. His appeal to the Canadian Cancer Society asked for support while acknowledging uncertainty about any definitive research answer.

On 12 April 1980 he began the Marathon of Hope near St John’s, planning to cross Canada. Alward drove the support van, and Darrell later joined the team. Public attention varied sharply between communities. Local supporters, charity organizers, journalists and business donors helped turn the run into a national campaign as it moved west through Ontario.

Cancer in his lungs forced him to stop outside Thunder Bay on 1 September 1980 after 5,373 kilometres. He did not complete the planned crossing. Fundraising continued while he received treatment; the campaign reached his goal of one dollar per Canadian by February 1981. He died in New Westminster on 28 June 1981. Later annual runs carried the work beyond his lifetime. His story joins determination to the collective infrastructure that made a public appeal possible, without suggesting that effort alone determines the outcome of illness.
summary.zh:
特里·福克斯的公共运动，成长于家庭、体育、残障经历，以及同其他癌症患者的关系之中。他1958年生于温尼伯，在不列颠哥伦比亚长大，通过持续练习参加篮球等运动。1977年确诊骨癌后，在新威斯敏斯特截去右腿。治疗期间与其他病人的接触，使个人体育挑战转化为资助研究的承诺。

他参加轮椅篮球，利用调整过的假肢训练长跑。队友、朋友、医护人员与器材技术人员共同支持。1979年，他与道格·阿尔沃德及弟弟达雷尔参加乔治王子城比赛，为下一步准备。向加拿大癌症协会发出的求助信，一面争取支持，也承认研究未必能给出确定答案。

1980年4月12日，他在圣约翰斯附近开始“希望马拉松”，计划横越加拿大。阿尔沃德驾驶支援车，达雷尔后来加入团队。各社区的关注程度差别很大。随着向西进入安大略，地方支持者、慈善组织者、记者和企业捐助者帮助长跑成为全国运动。

肺部癌症迫使他1980年9月1日在桑德贝郊外停下，当时已跑5373公里。他并未完成计划中的横贯旅程。治疗期间募款继续，到1981年2月实现每位加拿大人一元的目标。1981年6月28日，他在新威斯敏斯特去世。后来的年度长跑将工作延续至其身后。其故事把毅力与促成公共倡议的集体支持结构联系起来，而不暗示努力本身决定疾病结局。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1958–1981. The 1980 run began 12 April and stopped 1 September; the fundraising goal was reached in February 1981. Annual runs continued after his death. Endpoint and training pins are representative localities, not a surveyed route.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1958—1981年。1980年长跑始于4月12日、止于9月1日；募款目标于1981年2月达到。年度长跑在其去世后继续。终点与训练点位为代表性地点，不构成实测路线。

title.en: Marathon of Hope · Local support, media and continuing fundraising
title.zh: 希望马拉松 · 地方支持、媒体与持续募款

location.label: St John’s; representative Marathon of Hope starting locality

summary.en:
The Marathon of Hope began near St John’s on 12 April 1980 as a planned coast-to-coast run for cancer research. Its public reach was built unevenly. Some Newfoundland communities offered support early, while the team encountered places where publicity and arrangements were limited. Terry Fox’s running depended on Doug Alward’s driving, his brother Darrell’s assistance, and practical help from many people along the way.

Charity organizers, business supporters and journalism widened the audience. The Canadian Cancer Society’s Bill Vigars and Toronto Star journalist Leslie Scrivener helped bring the campaign to public attention in Ontario. Such work connected a moving team with local gatherings, donations and a national media audience.

When Fox stopped near Thunder Bay on 1 September 1980, fundraising continued. A CTV telethon followed on 7 September, and by 1 February 1981 the campaign had reached his goal of roughly one dollar per Canadian. Fox died that June; the first annual Terry Fox Run took place later in 1981. The original run, the subsequent fundraising drive and later recurring events are connected but distinct stages. This record examines the organization behind an enduring public campaign, without drawing an invented complete route or treating money raised as a measured clinical outcome.
summary.zh:
希望马拉松于1980年4月12日在圣约翰斯附近起跑，计划为癌症研究从一海岸跑向另一海岸。其公众影响并非同步形成。纽芬兰部分社区很早提供支持，团队也遇到宣传与接待安排不足的地方。特里·福克斯的长跑依赖道格·阿尔沃德驾车、弟弟达雷尔协助，以及沿途许多人的实际帮助。

慈善组织者、企业支持者与新闻报道扩大了受众。加拿大癌症协会的比尔·维加斯及《多伦多星报》记者莱斯利·斯克里夫纳，帮助运动在安大略获得公众关注。这些工作把流动团队与地方聚会、捐款及全国媒体受众连接起来。

福克斯1980年9月1日在桑德贝附近停跑后，募款仍持续。CTV于9月7日举办电视募款节目；到1981年2月1日，运动已达到大致每位加拿大人一元的目标。福克斯同年6月去世，首届年度特里·福克斯长跑于1981年稍后举行。原始长跑、后续募款与后来定期活动相互联系，却是不同阶段。本条考察持续性公共运动背后的组织工作，不虚构完整路线，也不把募得款项当作已测量的临床成效。

dateNote.en: 1980–1981 distinguishes the original run, post-stop fundraising and the first annual run. St John’s marks the start; it is not the location of all donations or the later annual events.
dateNote.zh: 1980—1981年区分最初长跑、停跑后募款及首届年度活动。圣约翰斯标示起点，并非全部捐款或后续年度活动所在地。
